messages:
micah: quick ping on PR #8573 — I ran extended 4k-token smoke runs and saw memory climb ~15% vs baseline. hoping for one or two quick eyes before we merge. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/8573 :eyes:
anya: thanks, can you attach the bench artifacts? which workload did you run (chat vs. generate)?
micah: ran `generate` path with 4 concurrent streams, batch_size=1, seq=4096. gist: https://gist.github.com/micah/4k-run-8573. key lines:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:03Z INFO tokens=4096 batch=1 p50=62ms p95=320ms rss=6.5GB
2026-03-15T02:17:10Z INFO tokens=4096 batch=1 p50=65ms p95=335ms rss=7.5GB
```
micah: baseline (main) for same config is ~p95=310ms rss=6.1GB, so p95 +25ms and rss +1.4GB. not huge but consistent across runs.
ryan: could be allocator fragmentation from the new allocator opt in. did you try `RUNTIME_ALLOC_CONFIG=compact`?
sara: also try lowering `prefill_workers` to 2 to see if KV cache parallelism is doing extra copies.
micah: good call, i'll run both. small note: this only shows up for seq>=3500, short sequences look identical.
ci-bot: perf-bench: artifact available at https://ci.internal/builds/8573/artifacts (size 48MB) :white_check_mark:
anya: if you can paste the `pmap`/rss breakdown or `jemalloc` stats that'd help. otherwise +1 to triage flags first.
micah: running compact alloc + prefill_workers=2 now, will paste logs. ETA ~20m. thx :pray:
ryan: if compact reduces fragmentation we can add a guarded flag and a simple microbench in the PR to catch regressions.
sara: also, if compact helps, please run a quick throughput sweep: batch sizes 1,2,4 to ensure no throughput cliff.
micah: update: compact alloc reduced peak rss to 6.4GB and p95 back to ~312ms. running throughput sweep now.
micah: sweep results (quick): batch1 p95=312ms rss=6.4GB, batch2 p95=210ms rss=6.9GB, batch4 p95=140ms rss=8.1GB. attaching logs to the PR.
anya: looks like fragmentation + batching tradeoff. I can +1 for merge if we add a follow-up ticket to add the alloc config as a runtime guard and a perf test.
ryan: +1 to that plan. maybe a canary rollout for a day too.
sara: +1, please add the ticket and a short note in the PR description about expected rss vs batch.
micah: added ticket RW-INF-1421 and updated PR description with artifacts. requesting quick LGTM from @anya and @ryan.
anya: lgtm from me.
ryan: lgtm.
micah: thanks all — merging in a few. will monitor canaries and post if anything odd shows up. :rocket:
